crosses=[(3,6,8),(4,13,4),(12,14,1),(14,3,2),(10,8,None)]
base=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
objects=[]
for r,c,color in crosses:
    cells={(r,c),(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)}
    objects.append((r,c,color,cells))
    if color is not None: base[r][c]=color
    for rr,cc in cells-{(r,c)}: base[rr][cc]=3
obstacles={(rr,cc):i for i,(_,_,_,cells) in enumerate(objects) for rr,cc in cells}

        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<n and 0<=cc<n:
            j=obstacles.get((rr,cc))
            if j is not None and j!=i: break
            if base[rr][cc]==0 or (rr,cc) not in obstacles:
                target[rr][cc]=color
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc

        elif v[r][c] is not None: val=v[r][c]
        elif h[r][c] is not None: val=h[r][c]
